purpose: Set the standard for making testimony safer without making it contextless or misleading.
central_warning: Removing names is not de-identification. Rare roles, diagnoses, dates, institutions, towns, family structures, rituals, and scene details can re-identify people.

required_transformations.rule: remove unless explicit named credit is approved; remove names of third parties by default
use broad phase or month/year only if needed; avoid exact date/time except public official sources
use country/region or setting type; avoid town/facility unless explicitly public and reviewed
use age band unless exact age is essential and safe
use trajectory band unless rare diagnosis is necessary and consented
generalize unusual combinations that identify a family
generalize unless contributor credit requires and safely permits it
preserve names and diacritics when permitted, but do not expose restricted interior content
remove or blur details that identify without reducing the record's core usefulness

recontextualization_requirements: Say whose perspective the account carries.
Keep the setting/trajectory/time band that makes the moment legible.
Do not overgeneralize one account into a common pattern.
Preserve negative space: what was not seen, not known, not asked, or not permitted to share.

review_thresholds.standard: editorial + contributor + clinical/tone or role review
specialist gate review; no public use until explicitly cleared
may remain permanently unpublished or represented only as refusal/restrictedness
